brief:
Clashes broke out between Palestinian resistance fighters and militias affiliated with Israeli forces near the "yellow line" in Shati refugee camp in northern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The armed engagement occurred as Israeli military artillery intensified its bombardment of the area.

Video documentation of the ambush operation, which targeted alleged Israeli collaborators, circulated widely during the fighting. Shati camp, located in the northern portion of Gaza Strip, has been a flashpoint for repeated confrontations between resistance groups and Israeli-backed armed units throughout the conflict.
